Two Inuit women and three children sitting inside a summer house on a low bench with cooking pots and utensils around them.
An Inuit family standing in front of a seal-skin tent on a coastline. Boxes and tins are scattered across the floor in front of them.
Portrait of Gusdiana standing behind a large dead bearded seal shot by Watkins lying upside-down on rocks.
Portrait of Gertrude (left) and Rebecca (right) in Sunday clothes. Rebecca is wearing a beaded collar which covers her shoulders and chest.
Getrud in Sunday clothes holding two husky puppies by their necks.

Group of Inuit men and women constructing a tent on a grassy slope using a wooden frame to prop up poles. Another woman and three children stand watching to the left. On the ground nearby lie more boards and poles.
Group portrait of Dina, Postadina and Gertrud posing while each holding dead ptarmigan in their hands. They stand in front of a stone dwelling.
Portrait of two Inuit women in plaid shirts.
Portrait of an Inuit woman (unidentified) standing, holding a small child in front of a sealskin(?) tent.
View of a tent being erected on a grassy slope by two Inuit men and a woman. Another woman is sitting on a box holding a baby.
Rebecca leaning on a wooden sledge with a rifle on her back. In one hand she is holding a number of salmon on a string.
Half-length portrait of an Inuit woman (unidentified) wearing jewellery.
A group of Inuit children sitting on the ground near the Base Camp hut. A plate and upturned can are in front of them. Snowy mountains in the distance.
Four Inuit men standing next to a dog sledge loaded with a dead polar bear. Another man is crouching down and holding the head of the bear towards the camera.
View of Captain Ahrenberg's Junkers seaplane being dragged over ice by a number of Inuit men with ropes. A crowd of women and children are watching from the side.
A group of Inuit men salvaging a De Havilland Moth biplane after a gale. One wing appears to be missing entirely.
An Inuit man in oilskin(?) suit entering or recovering from a capsize in a kayak.
Group of four Inuit men sitting on kayaks in line for a photograph. Each kayak is equipped with inflated seal skin buoys and white sheets designed to obscure the kayaker from prey.
Two Inuit men sitting in kayaks on a fjord during a hunt. Icebergs and mountains in the distance.
View of an Inuit man paddling a kayak among ice floes. Coastline in the distance.
An Inuit man sitting in a kayak equipped for hunting. Rocky coastline in distance.
An expedition member, smoking a pipe, tending to equipment beside a pyramidal tent. Three Inuit children stand beside him, one looking towards the camera. Rocky surface in background.

Three expedition members standing amongst wooden boxes beside Base Camp hut. Two Inuit women stand nearby, one appears to be mimicking the photographer and another Inuit woman sits on a box. In the foreground an expedition member stands on skis watching on.

Two Inuit sitting aboard a loaded umiak towed by a rope which stretches towards the camera. A small whaleboat motors alongside them with expedition members aboard. Photograph probably taken during the Open-Boat Journey. Snow-covered mountains in the distance.
Rebecca and an Inuit man standing in the doorway to wooden Base Camp hut coated in frozen spray. Two dogs stand at their feet.
Two Inuit men in kayaks, one behind the other, their paddles lying across deck with a white canvas sheet mounted in front. Rocky coastline in background.
An Inuit man lying prone with a rifle aimed through a small wooden stand and white canvas screen.
An expedition member with rifle slung over shoulder and holding a long wooden pole and an unidentified Inuit man also holding a rifle returning from a successful seal hunt.

An Inuit man, smoking a pipe, sitting on a sledge carrying out repair work on a piece of wood. Wood shavings lie on the floor around him and two buckets stand to one side. Water and rocky hillside behind.
Group of Inuit men, women and children standing, facing the camera, on a hillside outside a tent. Most are wearing white smocks, black trousers and caps. Fjord and mountains in the distance.
An Inuit man, looking towards the camera, sitting in a kayak with his paddle lying across the deck. Rocky coastline behind.
Two Inuit men on an ice floe, one leaning with his head close to a dead seal, the other watching on. A dead seal lies on a kayak behind them. Another kayak floats on water in the foreground.
Salo standing with a group of school children in front of an open door to a wooden building. Snow-covered mountains in background.

Group portrait of Inuit and European families posing in a room adorned with framed pictures. Pastor Rosling, native mission, is standing towards the left at the back with his four daughters and wife (sitting front right). Governor Rassow is standing at the back to the right and is holding his child, with his wife also sitting with a child on her lap (front left). W. E. Hampton(?) is standing furthest right. The others are unidentified. They all appear to be in their best clothes, with some wearing traditional Inuit dress. Possibly taken in the household of the Governor.

Nicodemus, Augusta and two women (unidentified) sitting on a bench inside a summer tent. Nicodemus is seated closest to the central tent support pole with Augusta by his side. They are surrounded by cans and cooking utensils.
Portrait of Rebecca standing on rocks wearing a beaded collar which covers her shoulders and chest.

Group of Inuit men and women standing beside a partially constructed tent comprising poles propped up by a wooden frame with hides draped over the top. A man smoking a pipe is lying on a low bench inside the tent.
Riley with his arm around an Inuit man (unidentified) standing for a photograph. Fjord and mountains in the background.
Gertrud wringing out an item of clothing over a large pan mounted on rocks. Mountains in the background.
Portrait of an Inuit woman (unidentified) in traditional clothing with baby in sling on her back.
Half-length portrait of an Inuit woman (unidentified).
Jamesi using a bowdrill on a piece of wood wrapped with leather straps. Around his feet are wood shavings, behind him lies an axe head. In the foreground is the wooden frame of a kayak.
Rebecca, Lemon and Stephenson sitting on sledges loaded with boxes on ice at Base Fjord. Harnessed dogs stand in shallow water in front. Snow-covered hillside in the distance.

View of De Havilland Moth biplane standing at the base of snow-covered incline. A group of people, including Inuit men and children, are posing for a photograph in front of the plane. A church is on a ridge in the distance.
View of an expedition De Havilland Moth biplane on skis A group of Inuit men and boys stand to the side watching. Snow-covered mountains in the distance.
Two Inuit men teaching rolling. They are floating in kayaks holding another upside-down kayak between them. Rocky coastline behind them.

Three Inuit men paddling kayaks with icebergs behind them before leaving the expedition for home. The kayaks are equipped for hunting with white sheets erected to hide the hunters and inflated seal skin buoys.
An Inuit man looking towards the camera while hunting in a kayak. A white sheet is erected at the front of the kayak to obscure him from view and an inflated seal skin buoy is at hand behind him.

An Inuit man, smoking a pipe, sitting in a kayak during a hunt. A white sheet is erected to obscure him from prey and an inflated seal skin buoy is at hand behind him. Rocky coastline in the distance behind.
An Inuit man sitting in a kayak during a hunt. A white sheet is erected to obscure him from prey and an inflated seal skin buoy is at hand behind him. Icebergs float on water behind him.
Three Inuit men sitting in kayaks during a hunt. Icebergs lie behind them and coastline in the far distance.
Four Inuit men in kayaks during a hunt. Each kayak is equipped with a white sheets to hide the kayaker from prey and behind each individual is an inflated seal skin buoy. Two dead seals float nearby.

Gino Watkins and five Inuit men standing on pack ice. Another man to the right of the scene is sitting beside an inflated seal skin buoy on a kayak drawn up on the ice. Rifles lie on the ground nearby. Ice floes in the water behind and mountains in the far distance.
View looking directly down on an Inuit man sitting in a kayak with a dead seal and inflated seal skin buoy on the deck behind him. Other hunting equipment is laid out in front.
Jamesi sleeping in Rymill's kayak. Only his head and hands are visible in the cockpit.
View of two Inuit men sitting, equipped for hunting, side by side in kayaks. Icebergs and mountains in the distance.
Portrait of an Inuit child sitting in a box against a wooden doorway to a hut.

Percy Lemon and Rebecca outside Base Camp Hut. Lemon, sitting on a wooden box, appears to be carpentering while Rebecca stands next to him watching on. A pickaxe, poles and other carpentry equipment lie around them.
